blocks.text: Govt. moves to reissue passports for first couple, review security protocols South Korea is scrambling to contain an unprecedented leak that exposed the personal information of President Lee Jae Myung and first lady Kim Hea Kyung, as well as senior aides, bodyguards and journalists accompanying them overseas. The exposure of the first couple’s personal information was alarming enough. But the breach also revealed the identities of presidential security officers assigned to protect Lee at close range, raising deeper concerns about presidential security.
